scripts.build: (cd packages/ui && bun run build) && (cd packages/intelligence && bun run build) && (cd packages/manifests && bun run build) && (cd packages/bidding && bun run build) && bunx tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && (test ! -d apps/web || (cd apps/web && bun run build))
scripts.lint: if rg -n '^import .*(@tauri-apps/api|.*apps/desktop|.*crates/daemon|.*supabase|.*transport)' packages/ui; then exit 1; fi && (cd packages/intelligence && bun run lint) && (cd packages/manifests && bun run lint) && (cd packages/bidding && bun run lint) && (test ! -d apps/web || (cd apps/web && bun run lint))
scripts.test: (cd packages/ui && bun run test) && (cd apps/desktop && bun run test) && (cd packages/intelligence && bun run test) && (cd packages/manifests && bun run test) && (cd packages/bidding && bun run test) && (test ! -d apps/web || (cd apps/web && bun run test))
